ideas.pitch: An AI-powered real-time transit companion built for Kent State students that predicts accurate arrival times and crowding levels across campus loops using computer vision and historical scheduling patterns.
ideas.title: Kent Campus Shuttle Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a persistent, daily pain point that every student judge and organizer at Kent Hack Enough feels firsthand during harsh Ohio weather.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local civic issue reporter that automatically categorizes, prioritizes, and maps potholes, broken streetlights, and campus infrastructure damage for the city of Kent using geotagged photos and LLMs.
ideas.title: LocalFixer Kent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear measurable civic impact and addresses a real-world municipal problem relevant to the local university community.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent mentor dispatch and scheduling app tailored for multi-hour hackathons, pairing struggling student teams with the most qualified available mentors based on active tech stacks.
ideas.title: Hackathon Mentor Match
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain point directly experienced by event organizers and participants inside the room during Kent Hack Enough.

ideas.pitch: An interactive data visualization dashboard that ingests public EPA water quality metrics for Northeast Ohio and forecasts contamination spikes using lightweight regression models.
ideas.title: Ohio River Watershed AI Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous forecasting with an environmental angle that appeals to judges looking for tangible regional benefits.

ideas.pitch: A location-aware peer study group finder designed specifically for Kent State libraries and student centers, grouping students by active coursework and mutual availability.
ideas.title: StudySync Kent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student productivity and academic collaboration, making it immediately relatable to university judges.
